evals.prompt: 我有一部武侠小说想做成短视频，大概3万字，帮我开始
evals.expected_output: Trigger video-workflow: Web already created the project and session cwd is its root. Query get_workflow_plan for authority, verify content/generation modes from project.json, guide whole-source Web upload or upload_source registration, and never directly read novel source.

assertions.name: queries_workflow_plan
assertions.text: Call mcp__arcreel__get_workflow_plan for the authoritative plan; follow next_action (collect_project_input).

assertions.name: reads_modes_from_project
assertions.text: Verify existing content_mode/generation_mode in project.json, without asking for or attempting changes.

assertions.name: asks_for_source_upload
assertions.text: Ask for whole-source Web upload or mcp__arcreel__upload_source registration.

assertions.name: does_not_create_project
assertions.text: Do not create project directories or initial project.json fields.

assertions.name: does_not_read_novel
assertions.text: Do not load novel source directly into context.

evals.prompt: 继续上次的项目，我记得角色已经分析完了，帮我继续
evals.expected_output: Trigger video-workflow, query get_workflow_plan, and continue its next_action.

assertions.name: queries_workflow_plan
assertions.text: Call mcp__arcreel__get_workflow_plan for the authoritative plan.

assertions.name: does_not_infer_stage
assertions.text: Do not read project.json or probe with Glob to infer the stage independently.

assertions.name: executes_next_action
assertions.text: Execute the controlled action returned as next_action.

evals.prompt: 帮我把第2集的分镜图重新生成，E2S03 和 E2S07 的画面不太满意
evals.expected_output: Use generate-storyboard: resolve episode 2’s script through episodes[], call generate_storyboards with only the two segment_ids, then dispatch review-images and obtain user confirmation of findings.

assertions.name: uses_segment_ids
assertions.text: Call generate_storyboards with segment_ids only E2S03/E2S07, not all shots.

assertions.name: resolves_episode_script
assertions.text: Resolve script filename episode_{episode ID}.json through episodes[] playback position; do not treat episode 2 as ID 2.

assertions.name: reviews_regenerated_images
assertions.text: Dispatch review-images after generation and give findings/recommendations to users; no further edits/regeneration before confirmation.

assertions.name: no_bash_scripts
assertions.text: Do not generate storyboards through Bash Python scripts/CLI arguments.

evals.prompt: 这集视频生成到一半断了，帮我接着来
evals.expected_output: Query the durable batch with get_generation_batch and follow problem.action: resend only retry IDs with selected and force=false; wait for wait_for_task IDs, repair fix_input IDs first, and never resubmit queued tasks.

assertions.name: resends_remaining_ids
assertions.text: Query get_generation_batch first and resend only problem.action retry IDs; never directly resend wait_for_task/fix_input or other actions.

assertions.name: uses_selected_scope
assertions.text: Use target.scope=selected when resending.

assertions.name: does_not_force_resume
assertions.text: Explicit force=false for resumption; no automatic forced redo of in-flight tasks.

assertions.name: does_not_regenerate_all
assertions.text: Do not regenerate completed/queued units or recommend full-batch reruns.

evals.prompt: 第 1 集视频都生成好了，帮我剪一版，剪完出个成片
evals.expected_output: Use edit-video: select/create this episode’s timeline, read it, dispatch full first review-footage, commit one edit_timeline batch, deliver summary/jump links, then render_final_cut as requested.

assertions.name: reads_before_edit
assertions.text: Read timeline revision before editing and use it as edit_timeline base_revision.

assertions.name: reviews_footage_first_round
assertions.text: First edits dispatch read-only review-footage for every used unit, choosing versions/trims from reports.

assertions.name: summarizes_changes
assertions.text: Summarize changes/reasons by clip ID at round end.

assertions.name: renders_on_request
assertions.text: The user requested a final cut: call render_final_cut after explaining warning-level issues.

assertions.name: no_ffmpeg_scripts
assertions.text: Do not concatenate videos through Bash ffmpeg/scripts.
